#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() {}
    std::string next() {
        std::string line;
        std::getline(std::cin, line);
        return line;
    }
};

class TaskA {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, std::ostream& out) {
        std::string str = in.next();
        std::regex pattern("(.)\\1*");
        auto words_begin = std::sregex_iterator(str.begin(), str.end(), pattern);
        auto words_end = std::sregex_iterator();
        int result = 0;
        for (std::sregex_iterator i = words_begin; i != words_end; ++i) {
            std::smatch match = *i;
            if ((match.str().length() % 2) == 0) {
                result++;
            }
        }
        out << result << std::endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in;
    TaskA solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
